summary: Frontend-only testing of new editorial /gifts page. All 48 assertions passed: page renders with data-testid=gifts-page, breadcrumb links Home->'/', hero pain headline present, gifts-hero-cta external + target=_blank, pain section has 01/02/03 + closing line, aspiration heading present, showcase has all 5 gift edits (the-ritual/the-vessel/the-gathering/the-keepsake/the-evening) with NO product links and NO prices/cart, final store band + gifts-store-cta external + target=_blank, all 7 Unsplash images loaded (naturalWidth>0), Header nav-gifts href=/gifts and navigates correctly.
